export async function archivedDaily(repo,filters){const p=[filters.from,filters.to],where=['day >= $1::date','day <= $2::date'];if(filters.build){p.push(filters.build);where.push(`dimensions::jsonb->>'build'=$${p.length}`);}if(!filters.diagnostic)where.push("NOT (dimensions::jsonb->>'diagnostic')::boolean");const rows=(await repo.db.query('SELECT day::text,dimensions::jsonb AS dimensions,data FROM daily_metrics WHERE '+where.join(' AND ')+' ORDER BY day,dimensions',p)).rows;return rows.map(r=>({day:r.day,build:r.dimensions.build,diagnostic:r.dimensions.diagnostic,...r.data}));}
export async function refreshDaily(repo){const rows=(await repo.db.query(`SELECT (occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AS day,build,diagnostic,count(DISTINCT visitor_id)::int AS browsers,count(DISTINCT session_id)::int AS sessions,count(*) FILTER(WHERE kind='run_start')::int AS starts FROM events WHERE received_at >= $1 GROUP BY day,build,diagnostic`,[new Date(repo.now()-90*86400000)])).rows;await repo.db.transaction(async tx=>{await tx.query('DELETE FROM daily_metrics WHERE day >= ($1::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE \'Asia/Shanghai\')::date',[new Date(repo.now()-90*86400000)]);for(const r of rows)await tx.query('INSERT INTO daily_metrics(day,dimensions,data,updated_at) VALUES($1,$2,$3::jsonb,$4)',[r.day,JSON.stringify({build:r.build,diagnostic:r.diagnostic}),JSON.stringify({browsers:r.browsers,sessions:r.sessions,starts:r.starts}),new Date(repo.now())]);});return {days:rows.length};}
